title: NexusDaemonMomentDirectiveRequest
description: POST /v1/daemon/moment-directive — set/show/clear the active Moment Directive (V1.151 P0 DF-76). Validation mirrors the CLI handle_set (apps/nexus42/src/commands/creator/moment_directive.rs).

action.description: Directive operation: set (create/replace), show (read active), clear (remove active).

id.description: Work id (kind=work) or world id (kind=world) the directive is scoped to.

insert_depth.description: Placement within the directive region. Defaults to tail.

ttl_kind.description: TTL kind: count down by assembling generations or chapter advances.

ttl_remaining.description: TTL count (spec §5 H5 lock: the input name matches the read-back `ttl_remaining` column).

clear_on_scene_change.description: Clear when the focused moment anchor changes between assembles.

replace.description: Replace an existing directive at the same scope.
